verdict.rationale: The only AI-related capability found is 'AI-powered creation of meeting minutes for official record keeping,' which generates content rather than surfacing insights or suggestions derived from the user's own data. There's no evidence of AI-driven analytics, recommendations, or personalized suggestions based on a user's business data. Missing for 10: dashboard-level AI insights, data-driven suggestions/recommendations, any first-party or independent account of AI analyzing user data to produce actionable insights.
